scope: No-target valuation schema, arithmetic labels and full-universe broker disposition coverage.

actions.action: Added all required valuation fields to every current disposition using explicit not_published values rather than nulls or external targets.

Expanded the current disposition model from four primary names to all 13 covered tickers, each with zero house blend weights, evidence quality, blocking conditions and a re-entry validation condition.
Corrected external broker NP descriptions to CNY7.910bn for 000703, CNY6.454bn/CNY7.230bn for 300014 and CNY3.032bn for 002497.
Added a dated, diagnostic-only market-implied anchor to every current disposition and retained zero valuation weight where no independent denominator is reconciled.
Replaced eight genuine no-target null fields in the flat broker schema with explicit not disclosed statuses and kept all relevant evidence weights at zero.

guardrails: not_published is not a zero price, return, or target.
External-anchor evidence caps are not house valuation or portfolio weights.
No historic scenario value is reused as a current target.
